dataset_name: Image Dataset on Chili Leaf Diseases in the Krishna River Basin of the Deccan Plateau, India
location: Krishna River Basin (Guntur & Prakasam districts, Andhra Pradesh)

Healthy Leaves.description: Normal, vibrant green foliage with intact cuticle and no chlorotic or necrotic spotting.
Healthy Leaves.management: Continue balanced fertigation (NPK 120:60:60 + FYM 25 t/ha) and preventative bio-rational sprays.

Bacterial Spot.symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked circular spots with yellow chlorotic halos on foliage; leads to severe defoliation and blistered fruit.
Bacterial Spot.treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 30g + Streptocycline @ 1g per 10L water. Practice 2-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.

Chili Leaf Curl Virus.causal_organism: Chili Leaf Curl Begomovirus (ChiLCV) vectored by Bemisia tabaci (Whitefly) and Scirtothrips dorsalis
Chili Leaf Curl Virus.symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaf margins, puckering, vein thickening, shortened internodes, bushy stunted plants with few deformed fruits.
Chili Leaf Curl Virus.treatment: Rogue and burn infected plants early. Control vectors using Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1.25g/L or Fipronil 5 SC @ 2ml/L. Install yellow and blue sticky traps.

Cercospora Leaf Spot.symptoms: Circular spots with light grey/white centres and prominent dark brown borders (frog-eye appearance); infected leaves turn yellow and drop prematurely.
Cercospora Leaf Spot.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9 EC @ 1ml/L water at 10-14 day intervals.

Nutrition Deficiency.causal_organism: Micronutrient imbalance (Zinc, Iron, Magnesium, or Nitrogen deficiency)
Nutrition Deficiency.symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis, little-leaf clustering, pale yellowish leaf margins, and stunted vegetative canopy.
Nutrition Deficiency.treatment: Apply ANGRAU Formula 4 or multi-micronutrient foliar spray (Zn 0.2% + FeSO4 0.5% + Borax 0.1%) @ 2.5g/L at vegetative and flower-initiation stages.

White Spot.causal_organism: Fusarium pallidoroseum / Oidiopsis taurica (Powdery mildew white patches)
White Spot.symptoms: Irregular white to pale grey spots and powdery patches on lower leaf surfaces with corresponding chlorosis on upper blade.
White Spot.treatment: Ensure field drainage. Spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3g/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2g/L water.

angrau_extension_status: Aligned with ANGRAU RARS Lam (Guntur) Integrated Chili Disease Management Guidelines
